title: The Ashesi MBA
about: Ashesi University is accepting applications for The Ashesi MBA, a two-year part-time graduate programme, for academic year 2027/28. Applicants need a first degree or recognised professional qualification and at least three years of relevant work experience. Applications close on 31 July 2027.
requirements: Good first degree in any field from a recognized university with a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience, or a recognized global professional body qualification with the same experience
